body.name: Near-singular all-component conditioning family
body.construction: For \(0<t<1/3\), let \(\Sigma_0=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}\), \(\Sigma_1(t)=\begin{pmatrix}t&t\\t&1+t\end{pmatrix}\), \(\Sigma_2=\operatorname{diag}(1,2)\), and perturb only component one to \(\widehat\Sigma_1(t)=\begin{pmatrix}t&2t\\2t&1+t\end{pmatrix}\).
